details.usageInstructions:
Deep Fry
Preheat the oil in Kadhai/ wok with Max Temp of 175º celsius.
Take the product from the freezer directly and dont thaw.
Put the desired qty gently in the hot oil and deep fry for 3 mins.
Seal and keep the remaining product in the freezer.
Bake
Preheat the air fryer to 200º celsius.
Bake for 12 minutes until light golden brown.
Shake couple of times in between.
